description: TypeScript repo: ESLint's own no-empty-function next to Qualor's sonarjs pass (S1186, S1871, S3923); S1186 decorates no-empty-function, so the ESLint issue at the same line is primary

notes.src/a.ts#complexity: emptyHandler 1; pick 1+if+else-if = 3; allSame 1+if+else-if = 3 (a trailing plain else adds no decision point); total 7
notes.src/a.ts#cognitiveComplexity: emptyHandler 0; pick: if +1, else-if +1 = 2; allSame: if +1, else-if +1, trailing else +1 = 3; total 5
notes.dedupe: eslint:no-empty-function and sonarjs:S1186 both land on src/a.ts:2 (emptyHandler): the ESLint issue is primary by engine priority (data-model.md §5.3) and sonarjs:S1186 points at it as a duplicate. Dedupe runs server-side on tracked issues, not on this scan's report, so both findings are listed here.
notes.sonarjs#rules: S1192 (duplicate string) is off in eslint-plugin-sonarjs 2.0.4's recommended config and never fires; S1871 needs an if/else-if with no trailing else for a same-line branch to be flagged (a one-line branch body is otherwise ignored), and S3923 needs every branch of the conditional, else included, to match
notes.sonarjs#category: run.mjs copies each rule's SonarQube category from categories.json: S1186 Critical Code Smell -> high/maintainability, S1871 Major Code Smell -> medium/maintainability, S3923 Major Bug -> medium/reliability
